item.mythsofworlds.rune_igniter.desc: Use inside a closed runestone frame to open the way to Jotunheim
item.mythsofworlds.promethean_torch.desc: Ring a pool with Olympian marble, put braziers on its 4 corners and light them with the torch
item.mythsofworlds.medusa_head.desc: Right-click: turns the creatures in front of you to stone for 5 seconds
entity.mythsofworlds.medusa.petrify: Medusa's gaze is turning you to stone! Look away, raise a shield or wear a pumpkin
item.mythsofworlds.hydra_egg.desc: Right-click the ground: a tame little hydra hatches
item.mythsofworlds.wings_of_daedalus.des: Worn in the chest slot: a very high jump and a gentle glide down. Do not fly above y 200 in the sun: the wax melts
item.mythsofworlds.wings_of_daedalus.mel: The sun is melting the wax of your wings!
item.mythsofworlds.girdle_of_hippolyta.d: Worn in the legs slot: Strength II, Resistance II, Speed and Regeneration
item.mythsofworlds.journal.desc: Entries appear as you meet creatures and find places
journal.mythsofworlds.given: You find %s in your pack. Its entries will write themselves.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.title: Hero's Journal of Hellas
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.intro: Everything you learn about the world of the myths is written here. Meet creatures, defeat monsters and find places, and the pages fill themselves.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.portal.title: The Sacred Pool
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.portal.page1: Dig a pool from 1x1 to 8x8 and fill it with still water. Rim it with Olympian marble (8 marble around a gold ingot) and put braziers on the 4 corners of the rim.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.portal.page2: Light every brazier with the Promethean Torch (flint, gold, Olympian marble and a torch). The water turns gold: stand in it for 3 seconds. A brazier put out or broken closes the portal.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.satyr.title: Satyr
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.satyr.page1: Goat-legged follower of Dionysus, in Arcadia and the fields. By day he plays his pipes and leaves you be, at night he attacks. His pipes speed up other satyrs; his blow makes you sick.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.satyr.page2: How to beat: strike the piper first and do not let the herd surround you. Drops leather and wheat.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.harpy.title: Harpy
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.harpy.page1: Bird-woman with bronze feathers, in the mountains of Olympus and on the coast. She swoops from above, steals food right out of your pack and flies off.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.harpy.page2: How to beat: shoot her with a bow while she circles. Kill the thief to get your food back. Drops harpy feathers: with honeycomb they make the wings of Daedalus.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.spartoi.page: Bronze warrior grown from the dragon's teeth Cadmus sowed. Walks the fields of the dead at night and guards the dead ends of the labyrinth.
Special: once, he rises again after death. Strike him down a second time. Drops bones and iron nuggets.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.shade.title: Shade
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.shade.page1: See-through soul of the Asphodel Meadows and the Stygian Marsh. Blinks to a fleeing victim and heals with every blow it lands.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.shade.page2: How to beat: do not run, fight, and strike often. Sometimes drops an echo shard.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.pegasus.page: White winged horse, born from the blood of Medusa. Grazes on Olympus and the Elysian Fields.
Tame it like a horse. It jumps very high and glides gently down. Put a saddle on it.
Sacred hind of Artemis with golden antlers and bronze hooves, in the Arcadian Grove. Heracles chased it for a whole year.
The amazons keep tame hinds in the pen of their camps and in the courtyard of Themiscyra.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hydra_hatchl: Hatches from the egg the Lernaean Hydra always drops: right-click the ground with it. Tame from birth.
Follows its owner, sits on right-click, bites with poison and is immune to it. Heals on fish.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.greek_mercha: Lives in the agora. The trophy dealer pays emeralds for the horns, fangs, pelts and scales of monsters. The smith of Hephaestus trades trophies for weapons and armour.
The priestess sells ambrosia, the Promethean Torch, Olympian marble and potions.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.lion.title: Lion
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.lion.page1: A pride of lions lives in the Nemean Forest. They hunt sheep, goats and rabbits and leave people alone.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.lion.page2: Careful: hurt one and the whole pride comes for you. They breed on raw beef. Drop leather and meat.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.title: Amazon
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page1: Warrior woman of Themiscyra (40 health, damage 8, armour 10), in the camps and the city. She fights monsters, and if you hurt her she answers together with her sisters.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page2: Courtship: give flowers, gold, weapons, trophies or food, once every 20 seconds. Right-click with an empty hand: she says what she likes best, and that gift counts double.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page3: At affection 100, give her a wedding ring (a diamond over three gold ingots). Your wife follows you and fights at your side. Shift + right-click: follow, stay or wander nearby.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page4: Give your wife a cake and a daughter is born, once a day. In 20 minutes she grows into an amazon loyal to your family. Hitting an amazon costs a lot of affection.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.cyclops.page: One-eyed giant as tall as a house. Herds sheep in his cave and leaves travellers alone until struck.
Abilities: stomps and throws everyone around into the air, hits very hard. How to beat: keep your distance, shoot, and step back when he lifts his foot. Drops the cyclops eye.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.medusa.title: Medusa
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.medusa.page1: A woman with snakes for hair, in a ruined temple on the coast. Her bite poisons.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.medusa.page2: Abilities: her gaze slows you, and after 3 seconds it starts to turn you to stone. Protection: a shield in hand, a carved pumpkin on your head, or simply do not look at her.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.medusa.page3: How to beat: the harpe of Perseus hurts her twice as much. Drops the head of Medusa: right-click it to turn everything in front of you to stone.
Huge golden lion in a den at the heart of the Nemean Forest. Pounces on its prey.
Abilities: its hide turns swords, arrows and fists. Only potions (poison, harming, wither, also on arrows) and a dagger made from its own claw hurt it.

How to beat: six splash potions of lionbane (gold ingot, ghast tear, gold ingot over a bottle, blaze powder and a bottle, gunpowder below) kill the lion. Make a dagger from its claw (a claw over a stick). Drops its pelt and claws.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.karkinos.pag: The crab Hera sent to help the Hydra: small but vicious. Sits on the bank of its lair. In the myth it pinched Heracles by the heel, so he beat the Hydra only with Iolaus.
Abilities: its pinch holds you in place, its shell halves arrows. How to beat: Heracles crushed it under his foot. A jump attack does double damage. Drops a claw.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.minotaur.pag: Man with the head of a bull, 300 health. Shut in the arena in a far corner of the underground labyrinth.
Abilities: charges with his horns. Below half health he rages: runs faster and charges twice as often.
How to beat: sidestep the charge and strike his back. Take a thread, that is, leave marks, to find the way out. Drops his horn, gold and diamonds.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hydra.title: Lernaean Hydra
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hydra.page1: Five-headed serpent of the Stygian Marsh, 400 health. Its heads spit poison and its wounds close by themselves.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hydra.page2: Weakness: fire. It stops the regeneration for 10 seconds and burns three times as hard. A fire aspect blade cuts 2.5 times as deep at level I and 4 times at II.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hydra.page3: How to beat: fire aspect, flame arrows, lava. Beware of Karkinos nearby. Drops scales, emeralds, diamonds and a hydra egg.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.cerberus.pag: Three-headed hound at the Gates of Hades in the Asphodel Meadows, 450 health. Fire does not harm it.
Abilities: its bite sets you on fire, it breathes fire. At half health it calls up three shades.
How to beat: a fire resistance potion and good armour. Deal with the shades first. Drops fangs, blaze rods and diamonds.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hippolyta.pa: Queen of the Amazons on the throne of Themiscyra, 220 health. She attacks any stranger; her sisters come to help.
How to beat: bring her down to a sixth of her health and she yields: she stops fighting and hands over her girdle (Strength II, Resistance II, Speed and Regeneration, worn in the legs slot).

Marriage: she listens only to her victor and accepts only gifts fit for a queen: monster trophies, ambrosia, enchanted golden apples, netherite, the heart of the sea and the necklace of Harmonia (100 at once).
A new gift gives 20 affection, a repeat 10; anything else she scorns. The duel is forgiven once she yields. She turns away a married man. A child: ambrosia, once in three days.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.greek_temple: A marble temple with a colonnade and a golden frieze, on Olympus and the Elysian Fields, like the Parthenon. Inside are chests with gold, ambrosia and sometimes a Promethean Torch.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.oracle_of_de: Round sanctuary of Apollo in Arcadia and the mountains. In the Pythia's chests: bottles, glowstone, amethyst, enchanted books and bottles of experience.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.labyrinth.pa: On the surface you see only the entrance: a porch with red columns, black capitals and horns on the roof. Under it a spiral stair goes 20 blocks down.
Below is a 61x61 maze of bricks nothing can break. The entrance is in the middle, the Minotaur's arena in a far corner. Spartoi and hidden treasure wait in the dead ends.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.gates_of_had: Black basalt pillars and a sealed obsidian door in the Asphodel Meadows, lit by blue soul fire. Guarded by Cerberus; the chest holds obsidian, diamonds and netherite scrap.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.hydra_lair.p: A round pool of black water with lily pads in the Stygian Marsh, ringed by a broken wall and fallen columns. A chest in the middle, the Hydra in the water, Karkinos on the bank.
A ruined temple on the coast. Among the columns stand heroes turned to stone: statues of those who met her eyes. Bring a shield or a pumpkin.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.cyclops_cave: A stone dome in the mountains and on the coast. Inside: Polyphemus' sheep pen, a bed of hay, a hearth and a chest of wool, meat and iron.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.nemean_lion_: A cave of granite and moss deep in the Nemean Forest, strewn with bones. A pride of ordinary lions roams around.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.agora.title: Agora
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.agora.page1: The market of Hellas: a fountain with an iron guardian, four merchants' stalls, white houses with chests, a temple of Hermes and olive trees. Sell monster trophies here.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.ship_of_thes: A long ship with a black sail in the Aegean Sea, the one that carried Theseus home from Crete. A crew of shades on deck; in the hold a chest with a map, a compass and sometimes a trident.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.perseus_refu: The hero's small camp on the coast and in the mountains. The harpe and the mirror shield always lie here.
A palisade on the plain with tents, a fire, targets and a horse pen. Amazons live here. The chest sometimes holds a wedding ring.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.themiscyra.p: City of the Amazons behind marble walls with towers. A statue of Ares and olive trees in the courtyard, and in the north the throne hall with braziers, where Hippolyta sits. Gold and rings in the treasury.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.greek_farmst: A white house with a flat roof and blue shutters, as on the islands. A vine pergola, an olive tree, a beehive, amphorae, a well and a goat pen. Olives, honey and bread in the chest.

item.mythsofworlds.mjolnir.desc: Thor's hammer. Right-click: lightning strikes where you look (up to 40 blocks)
item.mythsofworlds.gleipnir.desc: The dwarves' fetter. Use it on Fenrir: the wolf is bound for 8 seconds, unable to move or bite
item.mythsofworlds.gleipnir.too_soon: Fenrir has only just torn loose, the fetter will not hold
item.mythsofworlds.surtr_sword.desc: Every blow sets the foe on fire
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.title: Skald's Saga
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.intro: A song of the lands of the giants. Meet creatures, defeat monsters and find the places of Jotunheim, and the skald adds new verses about them.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.portal.title: The Gate of Bifrost
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.portal.page1: Build a frame of runestone like a Nether portal: from 2 up to 21x21 empty blocks inside. Runestone: 8 stone bricks around lapis lazuli.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.portal.page2: Light the frame with the Rune Igniter (flint, runestone, a fang of Cerberus and a scale of Zmey Gorynych). The rainbow of Bifrost shines inside: step into it. Break the frame and the portal goes out.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.lands.title: The Lands of Jotunheim
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.lands.page1: Frost wastes and the giants' taiga, the Ironwood forest, the fjords and a cold sea. In the south the rift of Muspelheim smoulders, in the north the mists of Niflheim creep.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.lands.page2: Somewhere Idunn's orchard blooms: her apples of youth ripen on the leaves like fruit. The nights are long, and by day the sun drives the trolls under the earth.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.draugr.title: Draugr
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.draugr.page1: A dead man from the barrows in rusted armour. He walks the fjords, the wastes and the mists of Niflheim. The sun does not burn him; his blow freezes and slows.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.draugr.page2: Killed with a sword, a draugr rises once more at half strength. To lay him to rest for good, finish him with an axe or with fire. Drops rotten flesh and bones.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.warg.title: Warg
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.warg.page1: A huge wolf of the Ironwood, kin of Fenrir. They hunt in packs: hit one and the whole pack charges. It leaps at its prey from afar.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.warg.page2: How to beat: keep your back to a wall, fight them one at a time and do not run across open snow. Drops leather and bones.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.troll.title: Troll
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.troll.page1: A stone hulk of the taiga and the Ironwood. He hits hard and heals his wounds by himself, unless fire burns him. By day he hides in the shade.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.troll.page2: His great weakness is the sun: a troll in sunlight turns to stone and leaves a tusk behind. Lure him into the open at dawn.
A rime-thurs of the frost wastes, tall as two houses. His blow freezes: you move slowly and frost covers you.
How to beat: fire hurts him twice as much. Take a Fire Aspect sword and flaming arrows. Sometimes drops a frost heart.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.fire_giant.p: A son of Muspelheim from the fiery rift. He throws fireballs and his blow sets you alight. Fire and lava do not harm him.
How to beat: snowballs hurt him badly and water burns him. A water bucket and a stack of snowballs are the best weapons. Sometimes drops a Muspel ember.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.raven.title: Raven
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.raven.page1: A black bird, like Huginn and Muninn, the ravens of Odin. It lives in the taiga, the fjords and Idunn's orchard and harms no one.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.raven.page2: Tame a raven with seeds, like a parrot. A tame raven flies nearby and makes the monsters around its owner glow, so none can sneak up. Drops feathers.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.norse_mercha: They live in Viking villages and forges. The steward of the mead hall buys trophies and sells mead. The dwarven smith trades trophies for diamond gear.
The dwarf also sells Gleipnir, the fetter for Fenrir. The volva sells Idunn's apples, the Rune Igniter, potions and carved runestones.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.draugr_chief: A king buried in a barrow with his warband. He wears a golden helm and wields an axe; arrows barely pierce his armour.
He raises draugr from the ground and, like them, rises after his first death. Strike with an axe or fire. Drops the barrow crown.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.garm.title: Garm
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.garm.page1: The hound that guards the gates of Hel in the mists of Niflheim. His howl brings darkness and slows you, his bite weakens and freezes.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.garm.page2: How to beat: bring milk against the darkness and fight near walls where he cannot charge. Drops Garm's fang.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.thrym.title: Thrym, King of Giants
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.thrym.page1: The lord of Utgard, who stole Thor's hammer. He breathes frost ahead of him and stamps so hard that everything around flies off.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.thrym.page2: Enraged, he calls two frost giants. Fire hurts him twice as much; do not stand right in front of him. Drops Mjolnir.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.fenrir.title: Fenrir
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.fenrir.page1: The monstrous wolf, son of Loki, on the isle of Lyngvi. His bite withers, and a free Fenrir heals his wounds fast and calls wargs.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.fenrir.page2: Bind him with Gleipnir (use it on the wolf): for 8 seconds he cannot bite, barely moves and takes half again as much damage. Then the fetter snaps.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.surtr.title: Surtr
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.surtr.page1: The fire giant with the flaming sword, lord of Muspelheim. He hurls fireballs and kindles a ring of flame around himself.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.surtr.page2: Enraged, he brings down a rain of fire. Snowballs, water and Mjolnir's lightning hurt him more. Bring fire resistance potions. Drops the Sword of Surtr.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.viking_villa: A mead hall, longhouses, a smithy and the volva's hut above a fjord. The merchants of the North live here, and the chests keep supplies and mead.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.longship.pag: A ship with a dragon's head on the prow, off the fjords and out at sea. A chest of raiding loot lies in the hold.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.naglfar.page: The ship of the dead, built from nails. It sails the open sea with a crew of draugr. Take it: its rich chest is worth it.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.barrow.title: Barrow
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.barrow.page1: A grassy mound with a stone entrance. The draugr chieftain sleeps inside with his warband, beside his hoard of gold and enchanted weapons.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.utgard.title: Utgard
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.utgard.page1: The ice hall of the giants out in the wastes. Thrym sits on the throne, frost giants stand by the doors. The chests are full of trophies.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.fenrir_islan: The rock in the Ironwood where the gods bound Fenrir. The chains are broken and the wolf awaits. Do not come without Gleipnir.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.muspel_fortr: A black fortress behind a lava moat in the rift of Muspelheim. Surtr and the fire giants wait inside. Bring water, snowballs and fire resistance.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.helgrind.pag: Tall gates in the mists of Niflheim, the way to the realm of the dead. The hound Garm guards them.
A workshop in the rock where dwarves forge weapons. Gleipnir and diamond gear are sold here.
A ring of standing stones with glowing runes. Ravens live here, and a chest of offerings lies in the centre.
item.mythsofworlds.horn_of_themiscyra.de: Right-click: the amazons around go back to their camp
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page5: Above all, amazons love the necklace of Harmonia: give it and she falls in love at once (affection 100). It cannot be crafted; it lies in the treasuries of temples, the labyrinth and the monsters' lairs.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page6: Amazons keep to their camp. If they have wandered off, blow the horn of Themiscyra (a goat horn, gold and leather): everyone around goes back home.
entity.mythsofworlds.amazon.necklace: %1$s cannot take her eyes off the necklace of Harmonia. She is in love!
entity.mythsofworlds.amazon.necklace_alr: %1$s: "My heart is already yours. Keep the necklace."
entity.mythsofworlds.hippolyta.necklace: %1$s cannot take her eyes off the necklace of Harmonia. She is in love!
entity.mythsofworlds.hippolyta.necklace_: %1$s: "My heart is already yours. Keep the necklace."
entity.mythsofworlds.hippolyta.gift_agai: %1$s: "I already have such a gift, but it still pleases me." Affection: %2$s/%3$s
item.mythsofworlds.growth_potion.desc: Throw it: the young around (little amazons too) grow up at once
item.mythsofworlds.lionbane_potion.desc: Throw it at the Nemean Lion: it burns through the golden hide. Six bottles are enough to kill it
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.amazon.page7: Cannot wait for your daughter to grow up? Throw a splash potion of growth at her (a glass bottle, bone meal, a golden carrot and gunpowder): she is grown at once. The potion grows up any other young creature too.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.garm.page3: The hound of the cold mists dreads fire: while Garm burns, every blow hurts him twice as much. Bring a Fire Aspect sword or flaming arrows.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.thrym.page3: Thor was the bane of giants: Mjolnir strikes every giant and troll twice as hard, and Thrym, who stole it, three times as hard. Take it back and carry it to Muspelheim.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.fenrir.page3: While the wolf is free, the weapons of men barely wound him: every blow does only a quarter of its damage. Without Gleipnir he cannot be beaten - buy the fetter from the dwarf.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.surtr.page3: Surtr's heat blunts blades and arrows: they wound him only half as deep. Hold a frost heart, taken from the frost giants, in your other hand and your weapon strikes at full strength.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.orichalcum.p: Deep in the stone of Hellas lies orichalcum, the red gold of Atlantis. It needs an iron pickaxe; smelt the raw metal into ingots. Orichalcum gear is stronger than iron and takes enchantments well.
Higher in the mountains you find Hephaestus coal from the god's forges under the earth. In a furnace it burns twice as long as ordinary coal.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.dark_iron.pa: Deep in the stone of Jotunheim lies the dwarves' dark iron ore. It needs an iron pickaxe; smelt the raw metal into ingots. They make the toughest weapons, tools and armour.
In the rift of Muspelheim, embers smoulder in the stone. In a furnace they burn three times as long as coal, and valkyries prize them as trophies.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.valkyrie.pag: A shield-maiden of Odin (46 health, damage 9, armour 12). She lives in the halls of the valkyries in the fjords, the taiga and the wastes. She fights monsters and answers an insult together with her sisters.

As with an amazon, give her gifts once every 20 seconds: gold, weapons and shields, trophies of the North or a feast (mead, meat, Idunn's apples). Right-click with an empty hand: she says what she likes.
At affection 100 give her a wedding ring. Your valkyrie wife follows you into battle. Give her mead and once a day a daughter is born, who grows up a valkyrie.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.valkyrie_hal: A long hall hung with shields, with a stable of winged horses and a training ground. The valkyries live here, and they can be wed.

journal.mythsofworlds.greek.relics.title: Talaria and the Titan's Breastplate
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.relics.page1: The winged sandals of Hermes: speed, high jumps and no fall damage. Look in the cloud shrines and temples, or make them: harpy feathers, gold and golden boots.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.relics.page2: The Titan's breastplate: strength, resistance and a firm stance. Found in cyclops caves and the labyrinth, or made from an orichalcum chestplate, orichalcum, a cyclops eye and a hydra scale.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.god_sets.pag: Armour of different mythologies adds up to a set. Hellas: orichalcum, the Nemean lion set, the girdle of Hippolyta, the talaria, the Titan's breastplate. Jotunheim: dark iron, the helmet of Heimdall.
Union of the pantheons (both mythologies): 2 pieces give Haste, 3 also Fire Resistance, 4 also Regeneration. Two and two also give Resistance.
Hellas only, 4 pieces: Speed and Jump Boost. Jotunheim only, 4 pieces: Strength and Resistance.
journal.mythsofworlds.greek.cerberus.pag: In the fortresses and bastions of the Nether lies the bident of Hades, his master. Strike Cerberus with it or use it on him, and the hound falls at once. The bident works only once.

journal.mythsofworlds.norse.thrym.page4: Mjolnir's lightning melts sand into glass and chars the grass and soil around it into black scorched earth.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.heimdall.pag: Watchman of the gods at the Bifrost bridge in Himinbjorg, 450 health. He sees a hundred leagues and hears the grass grow: arrows hurt him only a third as much.
He blows the Gjallarhorn: everyone near is thrown back, slowed and stunned. At half health he blows it twice as often. Fight up close and step back when he raises the horn.
Drops the eye of Heimdall. The eye, gold and a dark iron helmet make the helmet of Heimdall: night vision, and every creature within 100 blocks glows through the walls.
journal.mythsofworlds.norse.himinbjorg.p: Heimdall's hall on a high terrace, with a watchtower. The rainbow bridge Bifrost runs down from the gate, and the watchman of the gods stands at its head.
item.mythsofworlds.bident_of_hades.desc: Strike Cerberus or use it on him: the hound of Hades falls at once. Works only once
item.mythsofworlds.bident_of_hades.banis: The bident returns to Hades, and Cerberus follows it to the underworld!
item.mythsofworlds.talaria.desc: Winged sandals: Speed II, Jump Boost II, air jumps with no cooldown (every press leaps again), no fall damage
item.mythsofworlds.titan_breastplate.des: Strength and Resistance, and you are hard to knock back
item.mythsofworlds.heimdall_helmet.desc: Night vision, every creature within 100 blocks glows through walls
item.mythsofworlds.relic.greek: Hellas: part of a set of the gods
item.mythsofworlds.relic.norse: Jotunheim: part of a set of the gods

journal.mythsofworlds.norse.pegasus.page: White winged horse on which the valkyries carry fallen heroes to Valhalla. Grazes in the fjords and the giants' taiga; two always stand in the stable of a valkyrie hall.
Tame it like a horse; the stable ones are tame already. It jumps very high and glides gently down. Put a saddle on it.

item.mythsofworlds.nemean_chestplate.des: A hide no arrow can pierce. Whole set: Strength, arrows cannot wound you

journal.mythsofworlds.norse.valkyrie.pag: Brisingamen, Freyja's necklace, wins a valkyrie's heart at once (affection 100). It cannot be crafted: look in the dwarf forges, Utgard and Himinbjorg.
The horn of Vingolf (goat horn, gold, raven feather) calls the valkyries home; the family whistle calls your wives and daughters to you from any world.

journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.title: Tales of Boyan
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.intro: Boyan the seer sings of Nav, the world under the roots of the World Tree. Meet creatures, defeat monsters and find places, and new tales write themselves in the book.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.portal.page: No gate is built to Nav: you go down along the roots of the World Tree. Make an acorn of the World Tree: an oak sapling, a gold ingot, glow berries and a horn of the Minotaur.
Plant the acorn on grass or dirt (right-click the top of the block). A great oak grows, with a hollow at its roots facing you. It needs a 3x3 space 11 blocks high.
Step into the hollow and stand for 3 seconds: you go down to Nav and come out by an oak just like it. Come back the same way. Cut the trunk by the hollow and it closes.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.lands.title: The Lands of Nav
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.lands.page1: An endless dusk hangs over Nav. The dense forest and birch groves, the kikimora bog, the wild field and the Sea-Okiyan.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.lands.page2: In the south flows the fiery river Smorodina, with the Kalinov bridge across it. In the north lies the realm of Koschei: grey earth, dead trees and bones.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.waters.titl: Water of Life and Dead Water
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.waters.page: Dead water closes wounds: Resistance II and Absorption III for a minute. The water of life heals at once and gives Regeneration II.
Baba Yaga sells both, and they turn up in chests. Karavai is a filling loaf: three wheat, an egg and honey.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.gods_gear.p: Sword kladenets: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1700, fireproof. Every blow also cuts the foes around: 6 damage within 3 blocks.

Seven-league boots: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 390. Speed III and Jump Boost.
Cap of invisibility: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 330. While you sneak, no one can see you.
Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.leshy.title: Leshy
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.leshy.page1: Master of the forest, a tall old man of bark and moss. Leave him alone, and he leaves you alone.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.leshy.page2: An angry leshy hits hard, and every blow blinds you and leads you astray: you find yourself somewhere else in his woods. Sometimes he drops an acorn of the World Tree.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.kikimora.pa: A small crooked bog spirit with moss for hair. She leaps out of the mire, and her grip drags you into the mud: strong Slowness and Hunger.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.upyr.title: Upyr
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.upyr.page1: A dead man who drinks the blood of the living: every bite heals him. The sun burns an upyr, but in the dusk of Nav he has nothing to fear. A smith forges a sword from upyr fangs.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.volkolak.pa: A sorcerer in the skin of a huge wolf. He hunts in packs and grows stronger in a fight. Merchants and smiths prize his pelt.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.rusalka.pag: A pale maiden with green hair in the bogs and by the sea. Her song draws you to her, and her cold touch takes the strength from your hands. Under water she swims fast.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.firebird.pa: A bird with feathers like embers. Stroke her with an empty hand and she lets fall a feather, once every two minutes. A feather in your hand lights the dusk: Night Vision.
Tame her with seeds, like a raven: she flies after you and lights up the monsters around. She lives in the groves and by the shrines.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.slavic_merc: A merchant and a smith live in the villages. The merchant takes trophies and sells karavai, honey and acorns. The smith forges trophies into diamond weapons and armour.
Baba Yaga lives in a hut on chicken legs. She sells the water of life and dead water, acorns of the World Tree and potions.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.solovei.pag: He sits in his nest on nine oaks over the road. His whistle is a storm: everyone around is hurt, thrown far back and dazed. Wounded, he whistles more often.
Stay close or shoot from afar, beyond 16 blocks the whistle cannot reach. He drops the seven-league boots.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.zmey_goryny: The three-headed dragon guards the Kalinov bridge over the fiery Smorodina. Up close all three heads spit fire at once, from afar he hurls fireballs.
Fire does not hurt him. While no one wounds him, his heads heal his body. Strike without a pause and bring potions of fire resistance. He drops the sword-kladenets.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.koschei.pag: The bony sorcerer-king in his black castle. His blow withers, and wounded, he raises upyri from the earth.
Koschei cannot be killed: he gets up again. His death is at the tip of a needle, the needle in an egg, the egg in a chest on an old oak. Find Koschei's oak.
Break the egg (right-click) and carry the needle. Then the last blow kills Koschei, and the needle breaks. He drops the cap of invisibility.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.slavic_vill: Log izbas with stoves and carved shutters, a well and vegetable gardens. A merchant and a smith live here.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.baba_yaga_h: The hut stands with its front to the forest and its back to the traveller, behind a fence of skulls. Inside are Baba Yaga, a stove, a cauldron and a chest of potions.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.kapishche.p: A ring of wooden idols of the old gods: Perun, Veles, Mokosh and Dazhbog look at the sacred fire. Firebirds live here.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.koschei_oak: An old black oak guarded by volkolaks. High in its branches stands a chest, and in it is the egg with Koschei's death.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.solovei_nes: A deck on nine oaks, woven with branches. A ladder leads up to where Solovei the Robber sits on his loot.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.kalinov_bri: A stone bridge over the fiery river Smorodina. On the far bank wait Zmey Gorynych and his hoard.
journal.mythsofworlds.slavic.koschei_cas: A black castle with towers and a barred gate. In the throne hall Koschei sits on a throne of bones, guarded by upyri.

journal.mythsofworlds.path.title: Codex of Myths
journal.mythsofworlds.path.intro: One book for every world. Chapters open as you walk the hero's path, and entries write themselves when you meet creatures and find places. In creative mode everything is open.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.welcome.title: How to Read the Codex
journal.mythsofworlds.path.welcome.page1: On the left are the chapters, one for each world. A locked chapter shows a lock and what will open it.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.welcome.page2:
Entries on creatures, bosses and places appear once you see or defeat them. Until then a question mark stands in their place.
The first page of each world is a map of its bosses in the order best taken. The gold ones are slain.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.order.title: Order of the Worlds
journal.mythsofworlds.path.order.page1: I. Hellas is open from the start: iron is enough. Half-bosses: the Nemean Lion, Medusa, the Cyclops. Bosses: the Minotaur (300), the Hydra (400), Cerberus (450).
journal.mythsofworlds.path.order.page2: II. Nav is opened by the Minotaur's horn: the acorn of the World Tree needs it. The two worlds can be travelled side by side. Bosses: Solovei (300), Zmey Gorynych (500), Koschei (550).
journal.mythsofworlds.path.order.page3: II. The Duat is opened by a scale of the Hydra: the ankh, key of the pyramid, needs it. It can be travelled alongside Nav. Half-boss: the Mummy of the Pharaoh (220). Bosses: the Sphinx (350), Set (500), Apep (600).
journal.mythsofworlds.path.order.page4:
III. Jotunheim is the harshest. The rune igniter needs a fang of Cerberus and a scale of Zmey Gorynych. Bosses: the Draugr Chieftain (350), Garm (400), Heimdall (450), Thrym (550), Fenrir (650), Surtr (800).
IV. Victory over Surtr opens the chapter of the far worlds.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.tiers.title: Tiers of Gear
journal.mythsofworlds.path.tiers.page1:
Iron: sword 6, armour 15.
I. Orichalcum (Hellas): sword 6.5, armour 16, toughness 1, durability 900. Reflection.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.tiers.page2: II. Bulat (Nav, ore deep below): sword 7.5, armour 20, toughness 2, durability 1700. Lifesteal and divine ward. Its pickaxe mines dark iron.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.tiers.page3: II. Meteoric iron (the Duat, ore deep below): sword 7.5, armour 20, toughness 2, durability 1650. Monster slaying and evasion. Its pickaxe mines dark iron.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.powers.title: Powers of the Armour
journal.mythsofworlds.path.powers.page1: The armour and weapons of the myths have powers the plain game lacks. They show in the item's tooltip and add up over everything you wear.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.powers.page2:
Reflection: that share of a melee blow strikes the attacker back.
Lifesteal: that share of the damage you deal heals you.
Monster slaying: more damage to the creatures and gods of the myths.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.powers.page3:
Divine ward: less damage from the creatures and gods of the myths.
Evasion: a chance that a blow or an arrow misses.
Fury: more damage while you are at half health or less.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.bearers.title: Who Gives What
journal.mythsofworlds.path.bearers.page1:
Orichalcum: reflection 5% a piece. Titan's breastplate: reflection 15%.
Bulat: lifesteal 2.5% and divine ward 3% a piece. Kladenets: lifesteal 10%.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.bearers.page2: Meteoric iron: monster slaying 3% and evasion 2% a piece. Khopesh: monster slaying 10%. Nemes: divine ward 8%. Pectoral of Ra: reflection 10% and divine ward 5%.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.bearers.page3:
Dark iron: monster slaying 5% and divine ward 5% a piece. Heimdall's helmet 10%, Mjolnir and Surtr's sword 15%, the harpe 10% monster slaying.
Nemean set: fury 5% a piece. Girdle of Hippolyta: fury 15% and lifesteal 5%.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.sets.title: Union of the Pantheons
journal.mythsofworlds.path.sets.page1: Four pieces of one world: Hellas - speed and jump boost, Jotunheim - strength and resistance, Nav - night vision and water breathing, the Duat - fire resistance and haste.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.sets.page2:
Pieces of different worlds together: 2 give haste, 3 also fire resistance, 4 also regeneration, and two and two give resistance.
The whole Nemean set: strength, and projectiles cannot pierce it.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.hud.title: Signs of the Myths
journal.mythsofworlds.path.hud.page1: Health, armour, hunger, air and experience are shown as carved bars with old-style numbers, and in the worlds of the myths a scroll at the top names the world.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.hud.page2: The H key (change it in the controls) or a button in the pause menu turns this look on and off right in the game. Finer settings are in the mod list, the Config button.
journal.mythsofworlds.far.title: The Far Worlds
journal.mythsofworlds.far.intro: Beyond the known myths lie two more worlds. Their pages are still blank: the skalds have not yet come back from there.
journal.mythsofworlds.far.hawaiki.title: Hawaiki
journal.mythsofworlds.far.hawaiki.page1: A warm sea and the islands of the Polynesian ancestors. No way there has been found yet.
journal.mythsofworlds.far.svarga.title: Svarga
journal.mythsofworlds.far.svarga.page1: A jungle of eternal noon, the heaven of the gods of India. No way there has been found yet.
codex.mythsofworlds.milestone.kill.surtr: Surtr is slain: the hero's path is walked
book.mythsofworlds.codex.landing: Everything you have learned of the world of myths is written here. Meet creatures, defeat monsters and find places, and the pages open by themselves.$(br2)The chapters of the worlds open as you walk the hero's path. In creative mode everything is open.

item.mythsofworlds.ankh.no_pyramid: This is no pyramid: a 5x5 base and a 3x3 step of pyramid stone, a gold block on top, a doorway in a side
item.mythsofworlds.ankh.opened: The gate of shadow opens! Stand in the doorway to pass into the Duat
item.mythsofworlds.sistrum.desc: Shake it (right-click): the priestesses of Isis nearby go back to their temples
item.mythsofworlds.khopesh.desc: Every blow withers the foe for 3 seconds
item.mythsofworlds.was_sceptre.desc: Right-click: a sandstorm throws back, blinds and slows the foes within 8 blocks (every 10 seconds)
item.mythsofworlds.relic.egyptian: Duat: a gift of the gods of Egypt

entity.mythsofworlds.set.eye_guards: The eye of Horus shields your eyes from the storm of Set
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.title: The Book of the Dead
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.intro: A scroll of the scribes of Thoth about the Duat, the realm of everlasting night that the barque of Ra sails through every night. Meet creatures, defeat monsters and find places, and new chapters write themselves.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.portal.pa: The way to the Duat runs through a pyramid. Make pyramid stone: 8 sandstone around a gold ingot give 8 blocks.
Build a 5x5 base, a 3x3 step on it, and set a gold block on the top. In the middle of one side of the base leave a doorway: an empty block with air above it.
The ankh: two gold ingots, lapis and a scale of the Hydra. Touch the pyramid with the ankh and a gate of shadow opens in the doorway. Stand in it for 3 seconds. Come back the same way.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.lands.pag: An everlasting night with stars hangs over the Duat. The sands with ruined columns, oases under date palms and the banks of the Celestial Nile with reeds and lotus.
The Fields of Aaru are the golden meadows of the blessed. Tombs stand among the red cliffs of the Valley of the Kings, and in the south burns the Lake of Fire, where the serpent Apep lies in wait.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.gifts.pag: Dates ripen among the palm fronds: right-click the ripe leaves. A honey cake is two wheat, honey and dates, and it heals. The sistrum of Hathor: gold, two nuggets and a stick.
The eye of Horus is needed against Set, the knot of Isis wins a priestess's heart. They are found in the chests of temples and tombs, and the priest of Anubis sells the eye.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.ores.page: Meteoric Iron ore: y -56 to 48, about 8 veins a chunk of up to 6 blocks, in stone and deepslate. Needs an iron pickaxe; Fortune gives more.

journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.gods_gear: Gifts of the Gods of Egypt
Khopesh of the pharaoh: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1650, fireproof. Every blow withers the foe for 3 seconds.

Was-sceptre: durability 250. Right-click raises a storm: the foes within 8 blocks are thrown back, blinded and slowed. Every 10 seconds.
Nemes of the Sphinx: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 330. Night Vision.

Pectoral of Ra: armour 8, toughness 2.5, knockback -5%, durability 528, fireproof. Fire Resistance and Strength.
Staff of Ra: durability 400, fireproof. Right-click hurls three fireballs. Every 2 seconds.
Flail of Osiris: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.2, durability 1650. Lifesteal 12%; the undead grow weak and slow.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.mummy.pag: A dead man in yellowed wrappings. The sun does not harm it, but the resin in the bandages burns: fire wounds a mummy twice as much. Its grip brings hunger and slows.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.scarab.pa: A black beetle of the sands with a blue-green sheen, as big as a cat. They come in swarms: touch one and the rest come too. The bite is poisonous. Sometimes they drop a shell.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.jackal.pa: A black desert dog with golden eyes, the guardian of the ways of the dead. Fast, and hunts in packs.
A giant scorpion of the goddess Serket, in a shell that turns light blows. Its sting carries a strong poison and weakness.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.ushabti.p: A servant figure of blue faience put in the tombs. In the Duat the ushabti wake and guard them. Arrows only chip the glaze, while a pickaxe cracks the clay twice as hard.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.bastet_ca: A black temple cat with golden eyes. Tamed with raw fish. Mummies and scarabs fear it, and a tame cat near its master gives them Regeneration.
Ra in the shape of a great cat slew the serpent Apep. Tame cats of Bastet throw themselves on Apep, and the serpent takes full harm only from a hero with a cat at their side.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.priestess: The servants of Isis live in her temples on the Nile. Courted like the amazons: gifts and a ring. They love lotus and flowers, gold and lapis, honey and dates, and trophies of the Duat.
The knot of Isis wins her heart at once, the sistrum of Hathor calls strays home. Give your wife a honey cake and a daughter is born, a priestess too.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.egyptian_: In the villages on the Nile live a trader of the market (buys trophies, sells dates and lapis), a priest of Anubis (the ankh, the eye of Horus, the sistrum, potions) and a smith (meteoric iron and trophy weapons).
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.pharaoh_m: A half-boss, 220 health, in a tomb in the Valley of the Kings. The curse of the tomb slows the hands and starves everyone near. Below half health he raises mummies.
Fire wounds him twice: bring burning arrows and Fire Aspect. He drops the khopesh, and his chest always holds an eye of Horus.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.sphinx.pa: A stone lion with a king's head, 350 health, by the Great Sphinx in the sands. It does not attack first. Its roar throws back and slows, and below half health blinds with sand.
Its body is stone: arrows only scratch it, while a pickaxe strikes twice as hard. Drops the nemes and its claws.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.set.title: Set
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.set.page1: The red god of the desert and of storms, 500 health, in a temple in the Valley of the Kings. His sandstorm wounds, blinds and throws back; he steps behind his foe and calls jackals.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.set.page2: Set tore out the eye of Horus, and Horus healed it and beat him: without the eye Set takes only a quarter of the harm, and with it his storm cannot blind. Drops the was-sceptre.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.apep.page: The serpent of chaos, 600 health, on an island in the Lake of Fire by the wreck of the barque of Ra. Its bite is venom, it spits venom from afar and sweeps with its tail. Below half health it calls scarabs. Fire cannot hurt it.
Bring a tame cat of Bastet: without one Apep takes only half the harm, with one half as much again, and the cat's bite tears it four times as hard. Drops the pectoral of Ra.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.egyptian_: Houses of mud brick with flat roofs along a canal, fields of wheat and reeds, palms and wells. Traders and the cats of Bastet live here.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.temple_of: Pylons at the gate, a court with a sacred pool and lotus, columns, and a sanctuary with the throne of the goddess. The priestesses of Isis and the temple cats live here.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.obelisk.p: A needle of stone carved with hieroglyphs, with a golden tip. At its foot an offering table and the chest of the priests, where an eye of Horus may lie.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.pharaoh_t: A mastaba with sloping walls in the Valley of the Kings. In the dark hall among the columns stands a sarcophagus of gold and lapis, guarded by mummies and ushabti.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.great_sph: A huge lion of stone with a head in the striped nemes lies in the sands. Between its paws is a hoard, and by the obelisks waits the living Sphinx.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.temple_of: Red walls under the night sky, columns with fires and a black altar with a flame. Here wait Set and his jackals.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.apep_lair: An island of black rock in a ring of lava. On it lies the wreck of the golden barque of Ra that the serpent dragged down, its sun disc still glowing.

journal.mythsofworlds.path.tiers.page4: III. Dark iron (Jotunheim, needs a diamond or bulat pickaxe): sword 8.5, armour 20, toughness 3.5, durability 2400. Monster slaying and divine ward.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.tiers.page5: The gifts of the bosses beat the metal of their world: kladenets and khopesh 8.5, Surtr's sword 10.5, Mjolnir 12.5.
journal.mythsofworlds.path.bearers.page4: Talaria: evasion 10%. Seven-league boots: 8%. Cap of invisibility: evasion 5% and divine ward 8%.

journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.flood.pag: Black silt lies on the low banks of the Nile and by the water of the oases. While water is near, the plants around the silt grow faster: sow your fields beside it.
Dig the silt with a shovel, or make it of two mud and bone meal. The gift of Hapi (silt, two bone meal and sugar cane) is the strongest fertiliser: it feeds every plant in a 5x5 square three times.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.gods.page: The gods live in the Duat. Most of them never strike first, but they accept a hero's challenge. Sobek and Sekhmet fall on strangers.
Each god drops a relic. Weapons are forged from it: staffs, sceptres, a khopesh, a bow, a spear, a glaive, a flail, a dagger and an axe. The recipe book shows how.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.gods_gear:
Sceptre of Isis: durability 250. Right-click heals 6 and gives Regeneration II to you, the players, pets and family within 8 blocks. Every 20 seconds.
Bow of Horus: durability 640. Arrows strike 2.5 harder, and whoever they hit glows for 10 seconds.

Glaive of Anubis: damage 9.5, attack speed 1.0, durability 1650. Monster slaying 15%, its blow slows.
Staff of Thoth: durability 400. Right-click: a word of power up to 24 blocks, 7 magic damage and Levitation. Every 1.5 seconds.

Dagger of Bastet: damage 6.5, attack speed 2.6, durability 1650. Evasion 5%, each blow makes you swift.
Khopesh of Sobek: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1650. Monster slaying 8%, its blow slows and weakens a foe in the water.

Sceptre of Hathor: durability 250. Right-click calms the monsters within 10 blocks. Every 15 seconds.
Axe of Ptah: damage 10.5, attack speed 1.0, durability 1650. In hand: Haste II.
Spear of Sekhmet: damage 9.5, attack speed 1.1, durability 1650, fireproof. Fury 12%, each blow sets the foe on fire for 5 seconds.
Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.crocodile: The sacred beast of Sobek lurks in the shallows and on the banks of the Nile. It swims as fast as it walks and never drowns. Its bite slows, and in the water it drags its prey down.
Its scaly back turns light blows. It drops its hide (one hide makes two leather) and sometimes a tooth for the khopesh of Sobek.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.ra.title: Ra
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.ra.page1: The falcon-headed king of the gods, 550 health, on the solar barque on the Celestial Nile. He hurls fireballs; below half health the eye of Ra burns and blinds everyone around.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.ra.page2: Fire cannot harm him. Drops the sun disc: with a gold block and a stick it makes the staff of Ra.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.osiris.pa: The green-skinned king of the dead, 400 health, on his throne in the Hall of Judgment. He raises mummies and slows his foe.
As Isis brought him back to life, he rises once from a death blow with half his health. Drops the djed: with chains and sticks it makes the flail of Osiris.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.isis.page: The great of magic, 360 health, by the throne in her temple. The wind of her wings throws back and slows her foes, and she heals herself.
Drops a wing of Isis: with a lapis block and a gold ingot it makes the sceptre of Isis, which heals you and your friends.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.horus.pag: The falcon-headed avenger, 420 health, in the temple with the granite falcons. He dives on his foe, and his eye makes them glow and grow weak.
Falls cannot harm him. Drops a falcon feather: with gold and string it makes the bow of Horus.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.anubis.pa: The jackal-headed guardian of the dead, 400 health, by the scales in the Hall of Judgment. The weighing of the heart withers and slows his foe and heals him.
Below half health he calls his jackals. Drops the feather of Ma'at: with meteoric iron and sticks it makes the glaive of Anubis.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.thoth.pag: The ibis-headed scribe of the gods, 340 health, in the Hall of Judgment. A word of power lifts his foe into the air and wounds with magic.
Below half health he steps away through the moonlight. Drops the tablet: with amethyst and a stick it makes the staff of Thoth.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.bastet.pa: The cat goddess, 340 health, in her temple among her cats. She is quick, pounces on her foe, and her claws poison.
She always lands on her feet. Drops a claw: with meteoric iron and a stick it makes the dagger of Bastet.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.sobek.pag: The crocodile-headed lord of the Nile, 450 health, in his shrine on the bank. He attacks on sight, drags his foe down in the death roll and calls crocodiles.
In the water he heals: lure him onto dry land. Drops a fang: with a crocodile tooth and meteoric iron it makes the khopesh of Sobek.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.hathor.pa: The goddess of joy with the cow horns, 360 health, in her shrine in the Fields of Aaru. The song of her sistrum makes heads spin and slows.
Below half health the rage of Sekhmet wakes in her. Drops a horn: with gold and a stick it makes the sceptre of Hathor.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.ptah.page: The craftsman who made the world, 420 health, in his forge-temple. Heavy and armoured, his word wakes ushabti and his blow numbs the hands.
Drops the chisel: with meteoric iron and sticks it makes the axe of Ptah, which gives Haste in hand.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.sekhmet.p: The lioness of slaughter, 480 health, by the Lake of Fire. She attacks on sight, breathes fire and sends hunger and poison.
Fire cannot harm her, and below half health she grows stronger. Drops an ember: with meteoric iron and a stick it makes the spear of Sekhmet.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.hall_of_j: The Hall of the Two Truths, where the hearts of the dead are weighed: columns under the stars, golden scales, Anubis and Thoth by them, Osiris on his throne.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.solar_bar: The golden barque of millions of years sails the Celestial Nile. The sun disc blazes on its mast, and Ra himself stands on the deck.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.temple_of: A temple of pale stone with granite falcons at the gate and the falcon colossus in the double crown.
The temple of Bubastis with the colossus of a black cat. The sacred cats of the goddess roam the court.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.shrine_of: A shrine of mud brick on the bank of the Nile, with a sacred pool in the court where crocodiles bask.
Rose stone in the Fields of Aaru, the colossus with horns and the sun disc, cows grazing around.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.forge_of_: A forge-temple of dark stone: anvils, a furnace and a basin of molten metal, with ushabti at work.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.shrine_of: Red walls by the Lake of Fire, fire and bones, the lioness colossus with the sun disc.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.nile_boat: A trading boat of papyrus bundles with a linen sail. A trader of the market sails on it.
journal.mythsofworlds.egyptian.papyrus_s: A fisherman's little boat among the reeds, with a net and the morning's catch.
